cards.card_text: A mocker does not love to be reproved, and he won't consult the wise either.
cards.verse_text: A mocker does not love to be reproved, nor will he consult the wise.
cards.snippet: A mocker does not love to be reproved, nor will he consult the wise.

cards.card_text: Next comes another group: 'There are those who hate the one who reproves in the gate and despise him who speaks with integrity.' Friend, that's getting MAD at the smoke detector.

cards.card_text: And when people oppose him, Paul says to reprove them, and HOW he does it matters.
cards.verse_text: He must gently reprove those who oppose him, in the hope that God may grant them repentance leading to a knowledge of the truth.

cards.card_text: Paul tells Timothy to encourage people, not only to reprove and rebuke them.
cards.verse_text: Preach the word; be prepared in season and out of season; reprove, rebuke, and encourage with every form of patient instruction.
